expected_impact: could attenuate or reverse the T2 ordering, because the LoftQ factors were fitted to a different residual than the one they are deployed against; this is named BEFORE the verdict so it cannot be offered as a post-hoc explanation
paper_value: the deployed pair is the schedule's own companion base Q_T = q(W - B_{T-1} @ A_{T-1}) with the factors A_T, B_T
reason: the frozen design isolates the ADAPTER initialisation by holding the base fixed across r1_std_2bit, r1_loftq_2bit and r1_loftq_2bit_t1; sharing the base is what makes the trend T2 a statement about the initialisation rather than about the quantizer
reproduction_value: the three R1 2-bit arms share the SAME base Q = q_NF2(W) (as reproduction-plan.md section 3.1 requires: '2-bit fake quant, same quantized matrix Q'), so the LoftQ factors are deployed against the plain PTQ base rather than against their own companion; the companion's reconstruction error is recorded as a metric instead of being stored
